theorems.name: Submission.deformation_im_completeness
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ J : ℕ, ∀ j, J ≤ j → ∀ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω, D ω = T ω - Tj j ω) → D.mass < ε) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
